diagnostic-tone.mp3 is a synthetic 440 Hz sine wave generated for the HTTP upload regression. It contains no user audio.
Generated with: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=0.12:sample_rate=44100 -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 320k -write_xing 0 -id3v2_version 0 diagnostic-tone.mp3
The regression repeats complete MPEG frames to exceed 6 MiB. This tests the product upload/configuration/persistence/export chain; it does not certify OBS playback.
